name: Semantic Embedding
description: Text embedding, similarity comparison, and semantic matching via configurable embedding provider. Provider names and models are in configuration, never in code.
description_cn: 文本嵌入、相似度比较与语义匹配，基于可配置的嵌入供应商。所有供应商名和模型在配置文件中，不硬编码在代码中。

credentials.name: embedding_api_key
credentials.description_en: API key for the configured embedding provider
credentials.description_cn: 嵌入供应商的 API 密钥

directives.description: Encode text into an embedding vector (256-2048 dimensions)
directives.description_cn: 将文本编码为嵌入向量（256-2048 维）

params_desc.mode: Dimension mode: A=256, B=512 (default), C=1024, D=2048

directives.usage_cn: 语义;相似,<文本A>,<文本B>[,<模式>]
directives.description: Compute pairwise semantic similarity between two texts
directives.description_cn: 计算两个文本之间的语义相似度

directives.description: Find the best semantic match among multiple candidates
directives.description_cn: 在多个候选中找出语义最匹配的一项
